teaching: Everything a lifetime takes in through the eyes, ears and thoughts is a marble in a stadium, and outside the stadium is the universe: the evident is a little pathway by a major road, while the real is larger than the universe (Tao Te Ching, Chapter 1, Thomas Cleary translation and notes).
youtube_title: Your Whole Life Is a Marble in a Stadium

word_overrides.why: the user asked to start on 'We unnecessarily': 'But' (1801.02) and the first 'we' (1801.38-1801.58) are cut; the second 'we' starts at 1801.62

envelope onsets (medium.en starts 'So' at 1746.38 and puts 'a' at 1747.64, inside the 2.5 s hesitation before 'human', which is cut). The clip starts at 1746.74, after a soft 'so'; 0.45 s of his room tone from the cut hesitation (1748.2-1748.65) keeps the pause after 'existence.'
large-v3 hears 'This is how many books'; medium.en drops 'how'. 'attention' before it runs to ~1762.4, so the clip starts at 1762.55
large-v3 (narrow pass) hears 'you can, you can experience'; the first 'you can' stays in the audio, off the captions
envelope onset 1837.86 (medium.en puts 'The' at 1837.50 in the pause)
he trails off: 'ball' is soft and late (envelope 1757.32-1757.70), 'max' is clear at 1758.56 (large-v3 hears 'ball. Max.'; medium.en puts 'ball' at 1756.42)

image.note: Rodin's Thinker: 'a human lifetime and what it's observed with its eyes and its ears and its thoughts' (the first attention; on the join)
a Korean chaekgeori screen, shelf after shelf of books, slowly panning: 'This is how many books you can read, how many courses… news items you can experience in a lifetime' (on the join)
Piranesi's Colosseum: 'The second attention would be the size of the largest stadium… a little marble in a huge stadium'
the Hubble Ultra Deep Field, thousands of galaxies in a speck of sky: 'outside the stadium, you have the universe… the third attention'
the Pale Blue Dot, Earth from Voyager 1, with an arrow and 'Earth': 'The evident is an edge of reality, like a little pathway by a major road' (on the join)
the Deep Field again, slowly widening: 'the real is the size of the universe. Larger than the universe' (under the end-card dissolve)
